source_text:
domain define-concept-disposition "Define concept disposition"
profile declarative-function-v1
owner cyberalchemy-define-owner
logic sfol-v1

schema DispositionFacts:
  action: string pattern "^(reuse|specialize|propose|open|defer|refuse|unsupported)$"
  definition_reference_present: boolean
  base_reference_present: boolean
  specialization_scope_present: boolean
  proposal_present: boolean

schema DispositionDecision:
  status: string pattern "^(accepted|block)$"
  disposition: string pattern "^(reuse|specialize|propose|open|none)$"
  repair_focus: string pattern "^(none|unsupported-action|definition-reference|specialization|proposal)$"
  authority_effect: string const "none"

mapping ReuseAccepted:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-DISPOSITION-REUSE"
  meaning "Accept reuse only with an exact definition reference."
  target DispositionDecision
  field status = "accepted"
  field disposition = "reuse"
  field repair_focus = "none"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping SpecializationAccepted:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-DISPOSITION-SPECIALIZE"
  meaning "Accept specialization only with an exact base reference and bounded specialization scope."
  target DispositionDecision
  field status = "accepted"
  field disposition = "specialize"
  field repair_focus = "none"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping ProposalAccepted:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-DISPOSITION-PROPOSE"
  meaning "Accept a candidate proposal only when a proposed statement is present."
  target DispositionDecision
  field status = "accepted"
  field disposition = "propose"
  field repair_focus = "none"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping OpenAccepted:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-DISPOSITION-OPEN"
  meaning "Preserve open, deferred, and refused responses as visible open meaning."
  target DispositionDecision
  field status = "accepted"
  field disposition = "open"
  field repair_focus = "none"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping UnsupportedAction:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-DISPOSITION-UNSUPPORTED"
  meaning "Block an action outside the bounded disposition vocabulary."
  target DispositionDecision
  field status = "block"
  field disposition = "none"
  field repair_focus = "unsupported-action"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping MissingReuseReference:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-DISPOSITION-MISSING-REUSE-REFERENCE"
  meaning "Block reuse when its definition reference is absent."
  target DispositionDecision
  field status = "block"
  field disposition = "none"
  field repair_focus = "definition-reference"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping MissingSpecialization:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-DISPOSITION-MISSING-SPECIALIZATION"
  meaning "Block specialization when its base reference or bounded scope is absent."
  target DispositionDecision
  field status = "block"
  field disposition = "none"
  field repair_focus = "specialization"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping MissingProposal:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-DISPOSITION-MISSING-PROPOSAL"
  meaning "Block proposal when no candidate statement is present."
  target DispositionDecision
  field status = "block"
  field disposition = "none"
  field repair_focus = "proposal"
  field authority_effect = "none"

rule ReuseIsAccepted:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-DISPOSITION-REUSE-ACCEPTED"
  meaning "Reuse has its required definition reference."
  condition input.action == "reuse" and input.definition_reference_present

rule ReuseNeedsReference:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-DISPOSITION-REUSE-NEEDS-REFERENCE"
  meaning "Reuse lacks its required definition reference."
  condition input.action == "reuse" and input.definition_reference_present == false

rule SpecializationIsAccepted:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-DISPOSITION-SPECIALIZATION-ACCEPTED"
  meaning "Specialization has both required fields."
  condition input.action == "specialize" and input.base_reference_present and input.specialization_scope_present

rule SpecializationNeedsEvidence:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-DISPOSITION-SPECIALIZATION-NEEDS-EVIDENCE"
  meaning "Specialization lacks its base or scope."
  condition input.action == "specialize" and not (input.base_reference_present and input.specialization_scope_present)

rule ProposalIsAccepted:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-DISPOSITION-PROPOSAL-ACCEPTED"
  meaning "Proposal has a candidate statement."
  condition input.action == "propose" and input.proposal_present

rule ProposalNeedsStatement:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-DISPOSITION-PROPOSAL-NEEDS-STATEMENT"
  meaning "Proposal lacks a candidate statement."
  condition input.action == "propose" and input.proposal_present == false

rule OpenIsAccepted:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-DISPOSITION-OPEN-ACCEPTED"
  meaning "Open, defer, and refuse all preserve unresolved meaning."
  condition input.action == "open" or input.action == "defer" or input.action == "refuse"

rule ActionIsUnsupported:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-DISPOSITION-ACTION-UNSUPPORTED"
  meaning "The normalized action is outside the supported vocabulary."
  condition input.action == "unsupported"

result EvaluateConceptDisposition:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-EVALUATE-CONCEPT-DISPOSITION"
  meaning "Validate one requested concept disposition before the host constructs its evidence record."
  when ReuseIsAccepted yield ReuseAccepted
  when ReuseNeedsReference yield MissingReuseReference
  when SpecializationIsAccepted yield SpecializationAccepted
  when SpecializationNeedsEvidence yield MissingSpecialization
  when ProposalIsAccepted yield ProposalAccepted
  when ProposalNeedsStatement yield MissingProposal
  when OpenIsAccepted yield OpenAccepted
  when ActionIsUnsupported yield UnsupportedAction

endpoint DefineConceptDisposition:
  target node-http
  runtime node>=26.8.1
  method POST
  path "/define/concept-disposition"
  input DispositionFacts
  output DispositionDecision
  result EvaluateConceptDisposition
  auth-env DEFINE_RUNTIME_TOKEN
  max-bytes 16384
  timeout-ms 1000
  error-status 422
  status accepted 200
  status block 422
